# gruid-sdl

[![pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/badge/codeberg.org/anaseto/gruid-sdl.svg)](https://pkg.go.dev/codeberg.org/anaseto/gruid-sdl)
[![godocs.io](https://godocs.io/codeberg.org/anaseto/gruid-sdl?status.svg)](https://godocs.io/codeberg.org/anaseto/gruid-sdl)

The *gruid-sdl2* module provides a [gruid](https://codeberg.org/anaseto/gruid)
Driver for using the [SDL2 library](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL2/)
to build native graphical applications.

The module's package is called sdl.  For it to work, you need to install the
[SDL2 library](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL2/Installation) on your system before.

Be sure to install the dev version of the package, for distributions that make
such a distinction. For example, in Debian-derived systems, a command like `apt
install libsdl2-dev` may be used.
